description: Tombs of Terror bosses C (phase 8 family 21): seventeen encounters of Saviors of Uldum's Tombs of Terror (ULDA_BOSS_41 to ULDA_BOSS_59 without 44, Trap Room, which is family 01's, and without 58, Jythiros of Questions, rejected below: Alda Petrik, Sandshaper Rhogi, Jolene Knottley, Belloc Brightblade, Wildtooth, Totally Normal Jar, Ilza Grimdrum, Craz, Ol' Barkeye, Kasmut, Lich Baz'hial, Taskmaster Maru, Janak, Water-Toting Murlocs, Sand Puffer Frog, Winged Guardian, Dire Bat). Boss deck lists are transcribed from hearthstone.wiki.gg boss pages (read 2026-11-14), by card name; tools/dungeon-run-catalog (step 'encounters') resolves the names against facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json, checks every card and writes data/dungeon-run/encounters-v1.json. Every Tombs boss hero prints 10 Health: Health is the act curve's, and the tier is the boss's level band read from its page's deck table (family 19's rule, verify/tools/gen/p8f19/tombs_tiers.py).
method: The wikitext of each boss page (action=raw) was read and its deck tables transcribed in table order with their own counts; a table of possible cards without counts is transcribed with count null. The Heroic table is the row's extend list. A page's level note and its chapter line are recorded in the row's schedule adaptation. Ol' Barkeye's and Winged Guardian's pages are the boss pages "Ol' Barkeye (boss)" and "Winged Guardian (boss)". The file is written by verify/tools/gen/p8f21/make_f21.py.

adaptations.note: Tombs boss heroes print 10 Health (the adventure set a boss's Health by level server-side): the fight's Health is the act curve's and the tier is the boss's level in its chapter, from its wiki page's deck table: levels 1-2 (a "10; 15" table of possible cards: 10 cards on level 1, 15 on level 2) = tier 1. The page names chapter 3 as the chapter the boss is first met in (after it, any completed chapter), which does not set its level.

The wiki lists the possible cards of the level 1-2 deck (10 or 15 of them, no counts). A combat tier fights with 30: each listed card once, a second copy of each, then the Heroic table's cards (once, then twice) until 30.

Listed cards the engine does not script (or does not admit for a boss) are replaced by a scripted card of the same role, named in the row's replacements (the encounters step records each one): Secret Plan (it Discovers a Secret for the boss; this row generates none) by Animal Companion.

Running Wild (2) draws a random minion of the boss's deck (its own deck, which the boss knows); if it is a Beast, a second copy of that card goes to its hand (while the hand has room). Offered while its hand has room and its deck is not empty (both counts are public).

The page names chapter 2 as the chapter the boss is first met in (after it, any completed chapter), which does not set its level.

The wiki's level-4 list has 25 cards. A combat tier fights with 30: the listed cards, a second copy of each non-Legendary single in table order, then the Heroic table's cards (once, then twice) until 30.

Sand Shapin' (3) shuffles a plain copy of an enemy minion's card (the board is public; never a run shrine) into the boss's deck as a public shuffle, marked "Summon when Drawn" (ULDA_BOSS_42e). When the boss draws it, it is summoned from its hand while the board has room and the boss draws a card (the Casts When Drawn rule, as family 04's Shadow of Death); with a full board it stays in hand as a playable card. Offered while the deck has room.

The client's Sand Rush Player Enchantment (ULDA_BOSS_42e2), Sandy Speed (ULDA_BOSS_42e3, "Has Rush") and the Sand Shapin Dummy (ULDA_BOSS_42d) are client script holders the text does not name; the summoned copy gets no Rush.

rejected.name: Jythiros of Questions
rejected.reason: Riddle of the Sphinx ("Guess which card the Boss will play to banish it") is a decision of the run player on the boss's turn (the wiki: it shows the cards in the boss's hand and the card it draws that turn) whose correct guess counters the boss's card of any type (the wiki: "it is immediately countered"; the first encounter to counter every card type). The engine's decision loop, the bosspilot harnesses and NativeMatch answer only the current player's decisions, and the engine counters spells only (Spell.IsCountered in PlayCard.PlaySpell); a guess moved to the run player's own turn and a counter limited to spells would be an invented mechanic. The encounter is left out
rejected.lift: client (a Windows lane, not step 9: step 9 adds no decision of the non-current player): a decision of the non-current player in the engine's decision loop, NativeMatch (the client prompt) and the harnesses, and a Counter for minion, weapon, hero and location plays in PlayCard
